name: Trajan
title: Emperor
summary: Trajan was a Roman emperor from AD 98 to 117, remembered as the second of the Five Good Emperors of the Nerva–Antonine dynasty. He was a philanthropic ruler and a successful soldier-emperor who presided over one of the greatest military expansions in Roman history, during which, by the time of his death, the Roman Empire reached its maximum territorial extent. He was given the title of optimus princeps by the Roman Senate.
notes: Trajan was adopted by Nerva as his successor, establishing the practice of adoption-based succession that characterized the era of the 'Five Good Emperors.' Dante placed him in Heaven in the Divine Comedy. His reign is often considered the pinnacle of Roman power and prosperity. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trajan
